profile.headline: Full-Stack Engineer | AI Infrastructure & Cloud-Native Apps | AWS · Cloudflare · Next.js · LLM Integration
profile.summary:
Full-stack engineer with 5+ years of professional experience building cloud-native applications and AI infrastructure — with a full-stack development background reaching back to graduate research in 2018.
 
I work end-to-end — from React/Next.js frontends to serverless backends on Cloudflare and cloud architecture on AWS. Recently I designed HIPAA-compliant AI research infrastructure for a university nursing lab (AWS + HPC hybrid), and I build LLM-powered systems using the Anthropic Claude API, MCP servers, and multi-agent coding workflows.
 
My work spans EdTech and healthcare research. With graduate coursework in Instructional Systems & Learning Technologies, I bring a learning-science perspective to how I design educational platforms and competency-based tools — pairing solid engineering with real user needs.
 
I'm equally comfortable architecting infrastructure, shipping product, and translating between technical and non-technical stakeholders. Bilingual in Korean and English.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant (Full-stack developer & Instructional Designer)
positions.description:
Designed and developed a web application that supports mathematical problem solving process in a game-based learning platform.
- Backend: Used Python/Django framework to develop rest APIs that adaptively provide learning support data based on gameplay performances and learner competency model.
- Frontend: Used Vue.js framework to create UI components of web-based learning support features.

positions.title: Researcher (Software Developer)
positions.description: Developed a Unity3D-based virtual agent simulation for training Motivational Interviewing approach.
